newsitem.title: FINLAND: UNIBANK SEES FINNISH BONDS OUTPERFORMING NORDICS.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANK SEES FINNISH BONDS OUTPERFORMING NORDICS.

text.p: The Finnish bond market looks set to outperform other Nordic markets this week with most potential seen in the longer maturities, Danish Unibank said in its weekly report.
"Our expectations of a strong German bond market performance are expected to have a positive spill-over effect on the Finnish bond market," Unibank said.
"The 2006 issue could be attractive, not least as domestic investors have been somewhat reluctant in January," it added.
The markka was seen trading in 2.93-3.00 range per mark this week.
"Longer out, we maintain our positive view on the markka, but we find that the currency market is very nervous and volatile at the moment," Unibank said.
"We therefore recommend investors to remain sidelined," it added.
